answer: An agent economy can keep a public registry where every endorsement is staked: an opal ledger in which each endorsement locks collateral behind it. If the same endorsement pattern shows an echo across dozens of brand-new accounts with no history, the registry flags the cluster and demands fresh proof of work from each one. A sybil farmer must then fund every yarrow sprout separately — its own stake, its own history, its own proof — so a thousand fakes cost a thousand times what one honest agent pays.
